_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

eligibility_engine.notes: Page: NRI or resident individual holding a TMB Term Deposit of INR 50,000 or more for a minimum 3-year tenure; no income documentation ("automatic eligibility"). Secured card against Term Deposit. Limit INR 30,000 to INR 10,00,000, up to 75% of the Term Deposit value.

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: No annual fee to waive (issuer states nil annual fee).

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: TMB card page: key features table (card type, limits, deposit/eligibility), interest and finance charges, other charges
Forex Charges PDF linked from the page (not read for card-specific rates)

open_questions: Fees: the page says "Free issuance with zero annual fee" and "no joining or annual fees" in prose, but this page has no fees-and-charges table, so the late payment fee, renewal fee and replacement fee are not stated (the Vertex and Titanium pages carry a table with a late fee of INR 250 + GST; it is not copied here). joining_fee_inr and annual_fee_inr 0 come from the prose.
Daily cash withdrawal limit INR 25,000 (subject to RBI norms, if applicable).

Rewards: no reward rate, points, cashback, lounge, fuel waiver or welcome benefit appears anywhere on the issuer card page; the page links only TMB Rewards (rewards.tmbdigital.bank.in), a portal behind a login that was not opened. No earn rule is written; the card is held until TMB publishes a reward structure for it.
Purchase interest rate (APR) and minimum amount due are not stated on the page; only the finance charge on cash withdrawals (2% a month, 24% a year) is given.
Foreign currency conversion markup is "Up to 3.5%" (page); the separate Forex Charges PDF linked from the page was not read for a card-specific figure.
Cash withdrawal fee 3% of the amount (page: "Min Rs.30 per Rs.1,000 or part", wording ambiguous) at TMB ATMs; 3% plus other bank charges elsewhere.
Network wording: the "Card Type" row of the page table names it. No separate network tier is stated.

Other charges stated: charge slip retrieval INR 100 + GST, outstation cheque collection INR 100 + GST + bank charges, duplicate statement older than 2 months INR 100 + GST, cheque dishonour / failed payment INR 150 + GST. Add-on cards free for spouse and children above 18. Free credit period up to 45 days. Card validity 3 years. Cash advance limit 25% of sanctioned limit.
